                /**
                 * Function to set  a cookie value and expiry
                 *
                 * Input:
                 *    - Name for the cookie
                 *    - Value for the cookie
                 *    - Number of days in the future the cookie should expires
                 * Returns:
                 *    - N/A
                 *
                 */
                function setCookie (cname, cvalue, exdays) {
                        var d = new Date();
                        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
                        var expires = 'expires=' + d.toUTCString();
                        document.cookie = cname + '=' + cvalue + ';' + expires + ';path=/';
                }
                function getCookie (cname) {
                        var name = cname + '=';
                        var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
                        var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
                        for (let i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
                                var c = ca[i];
                                while (c.charAt(0) === ' ') {
                                        c = c.substring(1);
                                }
                                if (c.indexOf(name) === 0) {
                                        return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
                                }
                        }
                        return null;
                }

                                        return OneTrust.GetDomainData().Groups[i].PurposeId;

                        }
                }

2. Change font properties to `inherit` in Safari.
*/

.scoped-tw ::-webkit-file-upload-button {
  -webkit-appearance: button;
  /* 1 */
  font: inherit;
  /* 2 */
}

/*
Add the correct display in Chrome and Safari.
*/

.scoped-tw summary {
  display: list-item;
}

/*
Removes the default spacing and border for appropriate elements.
*/

.scoped-tw blockquote,
.scoped-tw dl,
.scoped-tw dd,
.scoped-tw h1,
.scoped-tw h2,
.scoped-tw h3,
.scoped-tw h4,
.scoped-tw h5,
.scoped-tw h6,
.scoped-tw hr,
.scoped-tw figure,
.scoped-tw p,
.scoped-tw pre {
  margin: 0;
}

.scoped-tw fieldset {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.scoped-tw legend {
  padding: 0;
}

.scoped-tw ol,
.scoped-tw ul,
.scoped-tw menu {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/*
Reset default styling for dialogs.
*/

.scoped-tw dialog {
  padding: 0;
}

/*
Prevent resizing textareas horizontally by default.
*/

.scoped-tw textarea {
  resize: vertical;
}

/*
1. Reset the default placeholder opacity in Firefox. (https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/issues/3300)
2. Set the default placeholder color to the user's configured gray 400 color.
*/

.scoped-tw input::-moz-placeholder, .scoped-tw textarea::-moz-placeholder {
  opacity: 1;
  /* 1 */
  color: #dee4ec;
  /* 2 */
}

.scoped-tw input::placeholder,
.scoped-tw textarea::placeholder {
  opacity: 1;
  /* 1 */
  color: #dee4ec;
  /* 2 */
}

/*
Set the default cursor for buttons.
*/

.scoped-tw button,
.scoped-tw [role="button"] {
  cursor: pointer;
}

/*
Make sure disabled buttons don't get the pointer cursor.
*/

.scoped-tw :disabled {
  cursor: default;
}

/*
1. Make replaced elements `display: block` by default. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
2. Add `vertical-align: middle` to align replaced elements more sensibly by default. (https://github.com/jensimmons/cssremedy/issues/14#issuecomment-634934210)
   This can trigger a poorly considered lint error in some tools but is included by design.
*/

.scoped-tw img,
.scoped-tw svg,
.scoped-tw video,
.scoped-tw canvas,
.scoped-tw audio,
.scoped-tw iframe,
.scoped-tw embed,
.scoped-tw object {
  display: block;
  /* 1 */
  vertical-align: middle;
  /* 2 */
}

/*
Constrain images and videos to the parent width and preserve their intrinsic aspect ratio. (https://github.com/mozdevs/cssremedy/issues/14)
*/

.scoped-tw img,
.scoped-tw video {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

/* Make elements with the HTML hidden attribute stay hidden by default */

.scoped-tw [hidden] {
  display: none;
}

        methods: {
            toggleVisibleContent () {
                let isLimitedContent = document.getElementsByClassName('is-limited-content');
                let isExpandedContent = document.getElementsByClassName('is-expanded-content');
                this.toggleElementsVisibility(isLimitedContent);
                this.toggleElementsVisibility(isExpandedContent);
            },
            /**
             * Loop through a collection of elements and hide them if they're visible or show them if they're hidden
             * @param  elements - an HTML Collection of elements
             */
            toggleElementsVisibility (elements) {
                Array.from(elements).forEach((element) => {
                    let isVisible = element.style.display === '';
                    // if the limited content is visible, hide it else reveal it
                    if (isVisible) {
                        element.style.display = 'none';
                    } else {
                        element.style.display = '';
                    }
                });
            },
            hasImage () {
                if (this.Parent.data().headerData.hero_src) {
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            },
            setHeaderBackgroundImage () {
                if (this.hasImage()) {
                    let searchHeader = document.getElementById('search-header');
                    searchHeader.className = 'with-image';
                    let backgroundStyle = 'linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70) 100%), url(' + this.Parent.data().headerData.hero_src + ')';
                    searchHeader.style.background = backgroundStyle;
                }
            },
        },
        mounted () {
            this.methods.Parent = this;
            this.methods.setHeaderBackgroundImage();
        },
    }
    searchHeader.mounted();

    <script type="text/javascript">
        function toggleDropdown(section) {
            if (window.innerWidth <= 992) {
                const allSections = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-section');
                const clickedSection = document.getElementById('dropdown-section-' + section);
                const clickedMenuSection = document.getElementById('menu-section-' + section);
                const clickedMenuTitle = document.getElementById('menu-title-' + section);
                const clickedChevronIcon = document.getElementById('chevron-icon-' + section);

                // Check if the clicked section is already open
                const isOpen = !clickedSection.classList.contains('hidden');

                // Close all sections
                allSections.forEach(section => {
                    section.classList.add('hidden');
                    section.parentElement.classList.remove('bg-white');
                    section.parentElement.querySelector('.menu-header').classList.remove('bg-white');
                    section.parentElement.querySelector('.menu-header .text-lg').classList.remove('text-emerald-700', 'underline');
                    const svgIcon = section.parentElement.querySelector('.chevron-down svg');
                    svgIcon.classList.remove('rotate-180', 'stroke-primary-700');
                });

                // If it was closed, open it; otherwise, leave it closed
                if (!isOpen) {
                    clickedSection.classList.remove('hidden');
                    clickedMenuSection.classList.add('bg-white');
                    clickedMenuSection.querySelector('.menu-header').classList.add('bg-white');
                    clickedMenuTitle.classList.add('text-emerald-700', 'underline');
                    clickedChevronIcon.classList.add('rotate-180', 'stroke-primary-700');
                }
            }
        }

        function handleResize() {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 992) {
                const allSections = document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-section');
                allSections.forEach(section => {
                    section.classList.add('hidden');
                    section.parentElement.classList.remove('bg-white');
                    section.parentElement.querySelector('.menu-header').classList.remove('bg-white');
                    section.parentElement.querySelector('.menu-header .text-lg').classList.remove('text-emerald-700', 'underline');
                    const svgIcon = section.parentElement.querySelector('.chevron-down svg');
                    svgIcon.classList.remove('rotate-180', 'stroke-primary-700');
                });

                addClassToMenuSections();
            } else {
                removeClassFromMenuSections();
            }
        }

        function addClassToMenuSections () {
            if (window.innerWidth > 992) {
                const sectionsWithClasses = {
                    'Buy': 'pr-2',
                    'Sell': 'px-2',
                    'Hemmings Motor Club': 'px-2',
                    'Services': 'px-2',
                    'Motor News': 'px-2',
                    'Magazine': 'px-2',
                    'Events': 'px-2',
                    'About Us': 'pl-2',
                };

                Object.entries(sectionsWithClasses)
                    .forEach(([section, className]) => {
                        const element = document.getElementById(`menu-section-${section}`);
                        if (element) {
                            element.classList.add(className);
                        }
                    });
            }
        }

        function removeClassFromMenuSections() {
            const sectionsWithClasses = {
                'Buy': 'pr-2',
                'Sell': 'px-2',
                'Hemmings Motor Club': 'px-2',
                'Services': 'px-2',
                'Motor News': 'px-2',
                'Magazine': 'px-2',
                'Events': 'px-2',
                'About Us': 'pl-2',
            };

            Object.entries(sectionsWithClasses)
                .forEach(([section, className]) => {
                    const element = document.getElementById(`menu-section-${section}`);
                    if (element) {
                        element.classList.remove(className);
                    }
                });
        }

        addClassToMenuSections()
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    </script>
    <script id="core-site-navigation" type="text/javascript">
        function toggleSearchBar () {
            const searchBar = document.getElementById('top-nav-search-mobile');
            searchBar.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        function toggleMenu () {
            if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
                const navigationMenu = document.getElementById('menu');
                const hamburgerIcon = document.getElementById('hamburger-icon');
                const closeIcon = document.getElementById('close-icon');
                const searchIcon = document.getElementById('search-icon');
                const appContent = document.getElementById('app-content');

                navigationMenu.classList.toggle('hidden');
                hamburgerIcon.classList.toggle('hidden');
                closeIcon.classList.toggle('hidden');
                searchIcon.classList.toggle('hidden')
                appContent.classList.toggle('hidden')
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const carousel = document.getElementById('carousel');
            const prevButton = document.getElementById('prev');
            const nextButton = document.getElementById('next');
            if (carousel) {
                const carouselWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
                let scrollAmount = 0;
                const scrollStep = 300; // Adjust scroll amount

                const updateButtonsVisibility = () => {
                    if (scrollAmount <= 0) {
                        prevButton.style.display = 'none';
                    } else {
                        prevButton.style.display = 'block';
                    }

                    if (scrollAmount >= carousel.scrollWidth - carouselWidth) {
                        nextButton.style.display = 'none';
                    } else {
                        nextButton.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                };

                nextButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (scrollAmount < carousel.scrollWidth - carouselWidth) {
                        scrollAmount += scrollStep;
                        carousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollAmount}px)`;
                        updateButtonsVisibility();
                    }
                });

                prevButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (scrollAmount > 0) {
                        scrollAmount -= scrollStep;
                        carousel.style.transform = `translateX(-${scrollAmount}px)`;
                        updateButtonsVisibility();
                    }
                });

                updateButtonsVisibility();
            }
        });

        function updateDropdown (searchValue, dropdownId, dropdownListId) {
            const dropdown = document.getElementById(dropdownId);
            const dropdownList = document.getElementById(dropdownListId);

            dropdownList.innerHTML = '';

            if (searchValue.trim() !== '') {
                const searchSections = [
                    {
                        name: 'Vehicles for Sale',
                        url: '/classifieds/cars-for-sale?q='
                    },
                    {
                        name: 'Parts for Sale',
                        url: '/parts/search?q='
                    },
                    {
                        name: 'Services for Sale',
                        url: '/classifieds/services-offered/?q='
                    },
                    {
                        name: 'Articles',
                        url: '/stories/search/?q='
                    }
                ];

                searchSections.forEach(section => {
                    const li = document.createElement('li');
                    li.classList.add('px-4', 'py-1', 'hover:bg-primary-100', 'text-base', 'leading-100', 'cursor-pointer');

                    const a = document.createElement('a');
                    a.href = section.url + encodeURIComponent(searchValue);

                    const searchValueSpan = document.createElement('span');
                    searchValueSpan.textContent = searchValue;

                    const sectionNameSpan = document.createElement('span');
                    sectionNameSpan.textContent = ` in ${section.name}`;
                    sectionNameSpan.classList.add('text-primary-700', 'w-full', 'h-full');

                    a.appendChild(searchValueSpan);
                    a.appendChild(sectionNameSpan);

                    li.appendChild(a);
                    dropdownList.appendChild(li);
                });

                dropdown.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                dropdown.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('input', function (event) {
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
            const searchInputMobile = document.getElementById('search-input-mobile');

            if (event.target === searchInput) {
                updateDropdown(searchInput.value, 'search-dropdown', 'dropdown-list');
            } else if (event.target === searchInputMobile) {
                updateDropdown(searchInputMobile.value, 'search-dropdown-mobile', 'dropdown-list-mobile');
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
            const dropdown = document.getElementById('search-dropdown');
            const searchInputMobile = document.getElementById('search-input-mobile');
            const dropdownMobile = document.getElementById('search-dropdown-mobile');

            if (!searchInput.contains(event.target) && !dropdown.contains(event.target)) {
                dropdown.classList.add('hidden');
                dropdownMobile.classList.add('hidden');
                searchInputMobile.value = '';
                searchInput.value = '';
            }
        });

        function submitSearch () {
            const searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input').value;
            if (searchInput.trim() !== '') {
                window.location = '/classifieds/cars-for-sale?q=' + encodeURIComponent(searchInput);
            }
        }

        function handleResize () {
            const searchMobile = document.getElementById('top-nav-search-mobile');
            const appContent = document.getElementById('app-content');
            const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;

            if (viewportWidth >= 992) {
                searchMobile.classList.add('hidden');
                appContent.classList.remove('hidden')
            }
        }

        handleResize();
        window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    </script>
